lead: The future of innovative startups is uncertain as creditors have voted to liquidate Goterra, a food waste startup that struggled to secure funding.

stories.title: Creditors vote to put food waste startup Goterra in liquidation
stories.summary: Goterra, a startup specializing in food waste management through the use of maggot robots, has entered liquidation after failing to secure necessary funding. Creditors are likely to be left with significant losses as the company's assets are consumed by fees. This situation highlights the challenges faced by innovative startups in securing sustainable financial backing.
